Issue pulls every token of the current collateral basket from msg.sender using individual token allowances to the eUSD RToken contract, sending collateral to the configured BackingManager. It mints eUSD to caller or explicit recipient. Use current BasketHandler quote; source warns against infinite approvals. Inputs are collateral wrapper shares, not raw USDC/USDT/PYUSD; amounts use each collateral token native decimals.

Observed current official basket contains saEthUSDT, wcUSDCv3, gtusdcf, gtusdcp and senPYUSDmain (Aave USDT V3, wrapped Compound USDC V3 and three Morpho V2 vault shares). Composition is governable and not pinned by these function arguments. Source basket conversion uses basketsNeeded/totalSupply, ceiling for issue and floor for redemption; issuance quote includes a collateral issuance premium. No fixed dollar exchange rate or fixed basket promise.

Issue requires nonzero amount, issuance unpaused/unfrozen and a SOUND ready basket outside its warmup period. Ordinary redemption burns caller-owned eUSD without an allowance/delegated owner and transfers the current basket to caller/recipient; it is allowed with issuance/trading pause but not freeze and requires full collateralization. The separately admitted redeemCustom variant can redeem historical basket portions and caps each output at the caller pro-rata BackingManager balance; its expected-token minAmounts checks differ from ordinary current-basket redemption.

This 4.2.0 RToken implementation performs issue/redemption atomically, not the old delayed-issuance queue. Per-hour issuance/redemption throttles may force waiting/retrying; they do not create a funded pending redemption claim. Official settings observed basket warmup 15 minutes, issuance unpaused and system unfrozen; states may change. The separate two-week RSR unstaking delay is NOT an eUSD redemption delay and staking is not admitted.

Standard issue/issueTo/redeem/redeemTo have no per-call min-output/max-input/deadline; separately admitted redeemCustom provides expected-token minimum-receipt checks but no deadline. Basket updates, rounding, premiums, asset refresh/oracles, collateral token restrictions and BackingManager allowances can affect/revert settlement. The RToken methods have no explicit user KYC whitelist; frontend/underlying legal and token restrictions remain caller responsibilities, not waived by ABI permissionlessness.

Central Sourcify implementation request returned 404, so explorer ABI/source were used; old constructor implementation was not substituted.
